title: Team Synergy recruitment
description: Recruitment closed on 10 September - three days before this was forwarded.
issue: The deadline had already passed when the message was sent. It still says 'apply before it closes'.

sources.excerpt: Deadline: 10 SEPTEMBER 2026 ... Don't miss out-apply before it closes!

title: FINIVESTA applications
deadlineText: TODAY is the LAST DAY to apply
uncertainty: 'TODAY' resolved from the send date, 13 September.

sources.excerpt: THIS IS YOUR FINAL CALL! TODAY is the LAST DAY to apply

title: Hostel allotment corrections
description: If your name was missing from the hostel list, corrections closed on 29 August at 10 AM.
uncertainty: 'Tomorrow' resolved from the send date, 28 August.
issue: The coordinator asked for replies in DM, but students kept replying in the group, so several corrections may never have been collected.

sources.excerpt: Hostel allotment list ... If your name is NOT there, please reply ... Deadline tomorrow 10 AM

title: Vice Chancellor Internship Scheme
uncertainty: Says 'Monday' with no date. Sent Thursday 27 August, so most likely Monday 31 August - never stated.

sources.excerpt: submit their application by Monday. Applications submitted after Monday will NOT be accepted

title: MSc Society interviews
description: Postponed on 10 September. A new date has still not been announced.
deadlineText: today's interviews have been postponed. New date will be shared soon
uncertainty: No new date has been given in the five days since.
issue: The postponement was posted at 8:45 AM in a different group that these applicants were never added to. They waited outside from 9:15.

sources.excerpt: update MSc Society ke alag group mein aaya hai, hum jo iss group mein hain unko toh add hi nahi kiya gaya

title: Technique Society interview
description: Rained off on Wednesday, moved to Friday 11 September. Now past.
deadlineText: New date: Friday, 11:00 AM, same venue

sources.excerpt: Due to heavy rainfall, today's interviews stand cancelled ... New date: Friday, 11:00 AM, same venue

title: Python assignment
description: Was due on a Friday that was never specified. Both candidate Fridays have passed.
uncertainty: The professor said 'Friday' in class with no date and no time. From a 3 September message that could mean 4 September or 11 September. The portal showed no deadline at all.

sources.excerpt: Python assignment 'Friday tak' submit karna hai ... ye Friday konsa hai - kal wala ya agle hafte wala?

title: Minerva orientation
description: Happened on 7 September after a last-minute time change.
uncertainty: Announced as a timing change but the original time was never stated, so what changed is unknowable. The venue was disputed throughout.

sources.excerpt: There has been a small change in the timing...
